quotes.text: How can we be expected as parents to protect our children from the dangers of social media and artificial intelligence that we hear about daily? It shouldn't just be on us.

I'm a mom with kids, and so I feel deeply concerned about the advancement of technology. We need guardrails. We need to protect our kids. We need to protect our jobs. We need to make sure that we are protecting consumers from rising energy costs. We need to make sure that we hold accountable companies that are benefiting trillions of dollars off the backs of hard working families in this district.

Oh, absolutely. In fact, I have an entire plan on my on my website as well. But we need things like the stop endless scrolling and parameters for social media for our kids. We need to continue to have hard conversations with those who are developing and make sure that there is safe, secure systems in place to make sure that we are keeping our communities and our kids safe.
